summary: FMC Corp filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a $1.2 billion private offering of 8.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2031, issued at par. Net proceeds of approximately $1.185 billion are intended to repurchase or redeem outstanding 3.200% Senior Notes due 2026, repay credit facility borrowings, and for general corporate purposes. The notes are secured by first-priority liens on assets of FMC and certain guarantor subsidiaries. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
